name: Decision
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean). The outcome for one submission version: accept/refer/decline (or bound/sanction_referral at bind), premium, terms, reasons, issued document references. Append-only — never updated after creation (contract artefact 3 §3, record 'decision'). One instance per decision; decision_seq is the only ordering key.
label: Decision

quote_id.title: Quote id (distributor record id)
quote_id.description: The distributor's quote record id. Rides the projection subject — must be free of '.' and '@' (plan §9, recon-h trap 2).

product_code.title: Product code
product_code.description: Single-valued by the time a decision exists (01-key-list.json system_keys).

quote_expire_timer_topic.title: quote-expire timer topic
quote_expire_timer_topic.description: The stored, derived topic for the 'quote-expire:<quoteId>' schedule — the ONLY thing microstrate.hub.delete.unschedule-flow accepts (contract artefact 5 timer 5). Written on the decision that stamped quote_validity_expiry, and read by flow 2 quote-bind to cancel the timer when the quote binds. Three states: absent/null = never scheduled or the stamp write failed; empty string = deliberately not scheduled because quote_validity_expiry was already past; non-empty = the live topic.

product_version.title: Product version
product_version.description: The authoritative copy (contract artefact 3 §7). Stamped at creation on submission, carried onto the decision that decided it.

submission_id.title: Submission id
submission_id.description: The submission record id this decision decided. Distinct from quote_id: one quote has many submission versions and one decision per version.

submission_version.title: Submission version
submission_version.description: Descriptive only — NOT the ordering key. See decision_seq (contract artefact 3 §5, §8.9).

distributor_account_id.title: Distributor account id
distributor_account_id.description: From the session at the flow that created this instance, never from a message body.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: The engine's verdict, plus the two bind-time outcomes contract artefact 3 decision D4 requires. FLAGGED: 01-key-list.json system_keys froze this enum as ACCEPT/REFER/DECLINE only; BOUND and SANCTION_REFERRAL are added here per artefact 3's D4 ('flow-2 creates a decision instance with outcome_status BOUND (or SANCTION_REFERRAL)'). Recommend artefact 1 adopt the 5-value enum.

decision_status.title: Decision status
decision_status.description: Positive by design. The referral queue is decision_status:OPEN, never 'not closed' (01-key-list.json system_keys).

sanctions_state.title: Sanctions state
sanctions_state.description: A hit produces SANCTION_REFERRAL and a compliance task in Antipodean's account (spec §4.4 / plan §7.5.4).

decided_at.title: Decided at
decided_at.description: Display only. Two publisher-side flows are not one clock — decision_seq is the ordering key.

superseded_by.title: Superseded by (decision id)
superseded_by.description: Forward pointer. Not indexed — decision_status carries the query.

referral_reasons.title: Referral reasons (rule names)
referral_reasons.description: Internal rule-identifier audit trail. Vocabulary is rule_output_names[].rule_name where outcome == REFER (01-key-list.json). NEVER crosses to the broker — these are rule names, not display text; see broker_reasons for what crosses.

decline_reasons.title: Decline reasons (rule names)
decline_reasons.description: Internal rule-identifier audit trail. Vocabulary is rule_output_names[].rule_name where outcome == DECLINE (01-key-list.json). NEVER crosses.

underwriter_notes.title: Underwriter notes
underwriter_notes.description: Internal only, never crosses (contract artefact 3 A16). An underwriter cannot amend a broker's answers on their behalf — plan §1.3.

issued_document_refs.title: Issued document references
issued_document_refs.description: References, not bytes — plan §1.8 pulls the bytes through P2a. Not indexable (array).

decision_seq.title: Decision sequence
decision_seq.description: THE ordering key — never submission_version, never decided_at (two publisher-side flows are not one clock). Minted from ONE account-wide numbergen counter DECISION_SEQ in the publisher's account, deliberately not year-scoped (contract artefact 3 §5, decision D1).

decided_by.title: Decided by
decided_by.description: 'engine' for flow-1/flow-2/flow-10; the underwriter's user id for flow-11. Never projected to the broker (contract artefact 3 §fields).

origin_flow.title: Origin flow
origin_flow.description: Which flow created this instance — makes assertion A1's one-writer-per-instance claim observable in data (contract artefact 3 §fields).

supersedes_decision_id.title: Supersedes decision id
supersedes_decision_id.description: Backward pointer. Append-only chain — there is no 'current' flag on a decision, because a flag would require updating the previous instance (contract artefact 3 §fields).

broker_reasons.title: Broker-facing reasons (display text)
broker_reasons.description: The 'Display Text (Broker)' column from spec §4.3's rule matrix. THIS is the array that crosses — becomes quote_outcome.reasons (contract artefact 3 §7, §fields).

underwriter_reasons.title: Underwriter-facing reasons (explanation)
underwriter_reasons.description: The 'Underwriter Explanation' column from spec §4.3's rule matrix. NEVER crosses — e.g. 'Revenue exceeds auto-quote threshold (>$15M)' discloses a rating threshold the broker is not told (contract artefact 3 A16, A20).

terms.title: Terms
terms.description: General terms of the accepted quote — limits, excess, endorsements, applicable clauses (plan §1.1 decision row; contract artefact 3 §fields FROZEN). Wave-1 authored shape; refine against contract artefact 6's merge-tag extraction in wave 7.

policy_number.title: Policy number
policy_number.description: Set only on the BOUND instance (contract artefact 3 decision D4).

bound_at.title: Bound at
bound_at.description: Set only on the BOUND instance (contract artefact 3 decision D4).

premium_basis.title: Premium basis
premium_basis.description: How the premium on this decision was arrived at. ADDED BY WAVE 4 under plan §4.2's [G1f] DECIDED 2026-09-02 block, whose third condition is that 'every premium it produces is stamped as provisional on the record, so a quote rated under the inferred formula can be found again when the real one lands'. PROVISIONAL_INFERRED means the ITPI combination was inferred by wave 4 from the shape of the supplied tables and Antipodean have not ratified it; CONFIRMED is reserved for a premium rated under a formula Antipodean have supplied; NOT_RATED means no rate table exists for the selected product (Allied Health and General Property today) and the decision carries no premium. Indexed, because 'findable later' is the whole point of the field. FLAGGED: recommend contract artefact 1 adopt premium_basis on decision_config, and artefact 2 adopt the keyword index entry.
